prompt: Redraw the supplied color image as clean black-and-white manga pen-and-ink art. Keep the same people, facial features and expressions, body proportions, poses, hands, hairstyles, clothing construction, accessories, composition and existing background. Keep actual lace, lettering, eyelashes and fine hair lines distinct from incidental texture; do not erase or thicken them.

Do not alter the face, expression, hands, costume construction or composition.
